# Lingofisy

> Lingofisy is an English language-learning mobile app for iOS and Android. It
> teaches practical, everyday English through short daily lessons, AI speaking
> practice with spoken feedback, and spaced vocabulary review. The in-app coach
> is named Fisy.

Lingofisy is operated from Berlin, Germany by Rasul Mammadov. The app is in
development; the website currently announces it ahead of the App Store and
Google Play listings.

## What Lingofisy does

- **Placement first.** A short placement experience sets the starting level
  instead of dropping every learner into the same beginner track.
- **Short daily lessons.** Most daily activities take about 5 to 10 focused
  minutes, built around vocabulary, grammar, quizzes and sentence-building games.
- **AI speaking practice.** Learners speak out loud and receive feedback on
  clarity and expression rather than on accent. Unlimited speaking practice is
  part of the paid Lingofisy Pro subscription.
- **Review that remembers.** Spaced repetition returns saved vocabulary before
  it is forgotten.
- **Progress tracking.** Streaks, XP, coins and weekly accuracy.

## Learning paths

- **General English** (CEFR A1 to C1) for everyday conversation and confidence.
- **Business English** (B1 to C1) for meetings, email and presentations.
- **IELTS preparation**, band-focused practice across speaking, listening,
  reading and writing. Lingofisy is independent and is not affiliated with,
  sponsored by or endorsed by the organizations that own or administer IELTS.

## Who it is for

Adult and young-adult learners who want usable English for work, travel, study
and conversation, from beginner through advanced. Available in English.
